usedFor: FuseDesk holds support cases and contacts, and Google Drive shares a file with them through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Case Closed” in FuseDesk, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Closing a case is a natural point to share a final document with a link and a set access level.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to anyone with the link, so never point it at a private document.
